authority: ../5205proj2.md: sections 2-5; existing signal, pair, execution, ledger and cost engines

model_contract.inputs: original seven-column official Elastic Net and GBDT predictions; no diagnostic replacement
model_contract.feature_definition: data/processed/panel_spec.json and existing common validity flags
model_contract.fitting: sector-specific monthly expanding fits from 2008; only labels mature by fit cutoff; existing preprocessing and locked hyperparameters
model_contract.implementation: consume the delivered monthly predictions; step 11 does not refit any model

phase_reset: each model/scheme/phase starts from cash 1 and no shares/pairs; no cross-phase carry
execution_time: next SPY trading day 09:30 observed open
phase_classification: signal-day split; final open liquidates only; end-date guard independent of label availability
final_test_signal_handling: 2026-09-29 schedules liquidation; 2026-09-30 no order; no October prices

eligibility.trading: known common_features_valid, finite nine-sector predictions, correct model month and available fit cutoff
eligibility.scoring: common_scoreable is for forecast scoring only; future targets/label flags never enter replay
eligibility.missing: incomplete nine-sector signal clears all pairs at next scheduled open; execution quote errors stop the run

threshold.selection_objective: equal-weight mean of six strategy mean daily (net portfolio holding return minus same-interval cash return)
threshold.selection_tie_rule: exact equality of unrounded float objectives; choose larger entry_bps; never round before ranking

pairs.retain: old pairs meeting the directional exit bound remain even outside today's top four
pairs.entry: only global top four absolute predictions, fixed ticker tie order; no rank-five backfill
pairs.reversal: requires full opposite entry eligibility; execute final net share change once

execution.spy: sum opposite SPY legs before sizing actual net shares and fees

accounting.order: old signed-share dividends, interval interest and borrow; NAV_pre; net share trades; execution fee once; NAV_post
accounting.nav: cash plus signed shares times observed open; short proceeds carry an equal security liability
accounting.dividend: old shares only at ex-date; long receives, short pays; new ex-date buys receive none
accounting.execution_fee: sum(abs(delta_shares)*open) * 3/10000, including initial/final and small rebalancing trades
accounting.interest: max(previous cash - interval-start actual net short collateral, 0) * exported interval RF return
accounting.borrow: interval-start actual net short collateral * 0.01 * natural calendar days/365
accounting.no_double_count: NAV changes already include prices, dividends and costs; never add target returns or adjusted total returns

statistics.initial_open: no synthetic zero-length return; first actual interval denominator is initial capital 1
statistics.daily_return: current NAV_post / preceding NAV_post - 1, except first real interval uses initial capital
statistics.cash_excess: daily net return minus the same exported open-to-open RF return; all cash days retained
statistics.annualized_net_return: (ending NAV / initial capital) ** (252 / number of holding intervals) - 1
statistics.volatility_for_step14: sample standard deviation (ddof=1) of daily net returns times sqrt(252)
statistics.sharpe: sqrt(252) * mean(daily cash excess) / sample std(ddof=1)
statistics.zero_trade: retain all cash intervals, report zero turnover/holding; zero excess std gives N/A Sharpe
statistics.drawdown_for_step14: minimum NAV/running maximum NAV - 1; ordered open NAV_post path includes initial pre-fee capital 1
statistics.turnover: sum(actual two-sided net asset trade notional/NAV_pre) *252/holding_intervals; include both ends; no half factor
statistics.holding_fraction: all intervals as denominator; position at interval START determines whether held

deferred.investment_benchmarks_step12: SPY fixed shares at same opens, dividends to interest-bearing cash, same entry/exit fees; cash compounds existing RF intervals
deferred.cost_comparison: one factor at a time, same 15/7.5 bps; independent ledgers; never select best costs
deferred.execution: steps 12-16 are not executed by this stage; broader audit, report and figures remain later

evidence_boundary.validation: already used for model and threshold selection; reused evaluation is tuning evidence
evidence_boundary.test: fixed-rule test-period strategy evaluation, not an untouched blind holdout
evidence_boundary.gbdt_provenance: Exploratory grid; previous project test results already known
evidence_boundary.training_oof: retrospective training-only signal-scale diagnostic; not an alternative official model
evidence_boundary.freeze_timing: frozen now before step-11 test portfolio replay; not a retrospective claim of freezing before earlier model exploration

historical_snapshots: old selected_threshold.json and unselected engineering/OOF flags are unchanged stage-specific snapshots
